project_type: Next.js 16.4 App Router dashboard with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4.3
build_system: Next.js with npm workspaces. Tailwind CSS via @tailwindcss/postcss
test_framework: No test framework currently configured in dashboard package
test_command: npm run typecheck --workspace @live-chat/dashboard && npm run lint --workspace @live-chat/dashboard
verification_instructions: Run typecheck to ensure TypeScript validity, run lint to check code style, run dev server and manually test sidebar toggle on both desktop and mobile viewports
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that need regeneration for this task
environment_constraints: Dashboard dev server runs on localhost:3000. Do not restart or interfere with API server on localhost:4000
contribution_requirements: No specific AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found in project. Follow existing code patterns and conventions
key_patterns: All components use local useState hooks for state management. No global state library. Tailwind utility classes for styling with CSS custom properties in globals.css. Lucide-react for icons. Components are client components marked with 'use client'. Mobile breakpoint is lg: (1024px) for sidebar visibility
directory_structure: apps/dashboard/src/app/ contains Next.js App Router pages and layouts. apps/dashboard/src/components/ contains reusable React components. dashboard-shell.tsx is the main layout component containing sidebar, header, and main content area. Currently sidebar is fixed at w-60 (240px) on lg+ screens, hidden on mobile with horizontal nav bar
